nodes.label: Cable Release BB Assembly
nodes.description: Ball-bearing based cable release mechanism with outer orange housing shell, internal green trigger plate, cable guide and actuator cylinder

nodes.label: Outer Housing Shell (orange)
nodes.description: Slotted cylindrical orange shell with mounting holes on flanges, surrounds the release internals

nodes.label: Actuator Cylinder (blue)
nodes.description: Light blue cylindrical pull rod / actuator that slides axially to trigger release

nodes.label: Green Trigger Plate
nodes.description: Inner green bracket/plate that holds the ball bearing detent and cable

nodes.label: Ball Bearing Detent
nodes.description: Metal ball used as detent that holds load until actuated

nodes.label: Red Grommet/Seal
nodes.description: Red ring/grommet visible near ball bearing, likely cable seal or stop

nodes.label: Axial pull -> ball release
nodes.description: Actuator cylinder pulled axially -> ball bearing disengages -> hook bracket releases load
